title: App Builder ChangeSet Risk Classification
description: Deterministic classification of a declared ChangeSet against risk surfaces. It decides which conditional review roles a change must buy. Produced by packages/control-plane/src/risk.js from config/risk-surfaces.json; never produced by a model.

severity.description: The highest matched surface severity, not an average. One blocker surface is enough.

surfaces.description: Matched risk surfaces, highest severity first.

requiredReviewers.description: Conditional reviewer role ids from config/agent-roles.json. Empty for an ordinary change, which is the common case.

rationale.description: Why each surface matched, so a required review can be argued with on evidence rather than asserted.
